svg.title: Geothermal technician — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as geothermal technician, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A steam wellhead has a wide flange and round upper valve between two light rising steam curls. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
